2026-09-22-automate-dependency-updates.old_req_name: Dependency updates are proposed automatically in every repository
Version-coupled dependencies are proposed as a single unit
A single logical version is updated in every location it appears
Updates automerge only when the CI gate covers their risk
Releases are not adopted until they have aged
Maintained upstream configuration is reused rather than reimplemented
Third-party GitHub Actions are pinned to immutable references
This project's own build outputs are excluded from automated updates
Proposal volume is bounded and scheduled
Every defined Playwright project is executed by CI
cloud-provisioning previews infrastructure changes on pull requests
cloud-provisioning CI runs its test suite
Automated merge is enabled through managed repository configuration
